items.title: How Do You Take a Picture of a Black Hole?
items.summary: Astrophysicist Shep Doeleman explains how capturing the first image of a black hole required a telescope the size of the world, and why the next goal is to create a movie. The post How Do You Take a Picture of a Black Hole? first appeared on Quanta Magazine
items.zh: 如何拍摄黑洞照片？

items.title: Magnetic sensors track muscle movement, for better prosthetic limb control
items.summary: Researchers hope to use these sensors to help people with amputation achieve more natural movements with their prosthetic limbs.
items.zh: 磁传感器跟踪肌肉运动，以实现更好的假肢控制

items.title: ULA's Vulcan rocket is set to return to flight on Friday the 13th
items.summary: This Vulcan launch will be first to use a full complement of 6 solid rocket boosters.
